target.statement: Average coincidence similarity between Fruchterman-Reingold layout distances and Ward-linkage cophenetic distances (and the full 6x6 similarity matrix) over 5,000 synthetic 2D datasets
target.dataset: Synthetic hierarchically generated 2D point clouds (5,000 datasets)

compute.basis: All components (synthetic data generation, scipy linkage/cophenetic, networkx spring_layout, coincidence similarity) are standard and cheap; the only cost is 5,000 FR layouts on small graphs, which is minutes-to-an-hour on CPU.

blockers: No code released; data generator parameters (n1, N2, sigma, number of points) not fully specified
Coincidence similarity index must be reimplemented from cited references
FR layout is stochastic, so exact matrix values will not match without the authors' seeds
title: Interrelating Fruchterman-Reingold Graph Visualization and Agglomerative Clustering
